newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: RESEARCH ALERT-Samsung Display a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Samsung Display a buy.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets said on Friday it has initiated its coverage of Samsung Display Devices with a "buy" rating.

"In spite of the slowdown in the global electronics industry, Samsung Display Devices enjoys steady demand and fairly resilient pricing for most of its products," said Bruce Gonyea, regional technology analyst at Paribas in Singapore.
Shares of Samsung Display, a unit of Samsung Group SAGR.CN, have suffered excessively from Samsung Electronics' problems, but Samsung Display's outlook is bright, he said.
"We expect a 27 percent rise in turnover and 47 percent net profit swell to 150 billion won for full year 1996," Gonyea said. Samsung is expected to post sales of 2.45 trillion won.
This compares to earnings of 102 billion won on revenue of 1.93 trillion in 1995.

Samsung, the world's largest producer of colour picture tubes, should benefit from the computer price war brewing in the United States, with gains from higher volumes in the fourth quarter offsetting any increased pricing pressure for cathode ray tubes, he said.
Samsung Dislay shares fell 500 won to 51,500 by the end of Friday's morning session. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5643
